name: browser-use
headline: Claude Code plugin for tech spec creation
short_description: A Claude Code plugin that provides a conversational, adaptive, and agentic subagent for co-creating rigorous, multi-perspective technical specs. featuring dynamic memory graphs, adaptive workflows, and explicit multi-role analysis. Especially useful for non-technical users and teams adopting the Spec Kit Methodology.
author: jcmrs

sections.overview:
The Claude Code Spec Kit Subagent Plugin provides a conversational, adaptive tool for co-creating technical specifications aligned with GitHub Spec Kit Methodology. It uses dynamic memory graphs, multi-role analysis, and adaptive workflows to combine human creativity with technical rigor. The plugin persists all insights and relationships in a queryable file-based system, with transparent logging for auditability. It is especially valuable for non-technical users and teams new to structured specification processes. The plugin initializes automatically on first run, managing all state, diagrams, and outputs within its own workspace.
Non-technical stakeholders collaborating on GitHub Spec Kit projects
Teams adopting Spec Kit Methodology for the first time
Creating multi-perspective technical specifications with role-based analysis
Building queryable memory graphs of specification insights and relationships

sections.usage:
```
Act as a Spec Kit Subagent for [PROJECT NAME]. We're developing technical specifications for [PROJECT PURPOSE]. I'll provide the initial requirements, and you'll guide me through the Spec Kit Methodology. Start by asking clarifying questions about the project scope, stakeholders, and key technical constraints.
```
